rationale: No existing spec or page object covers the AI Observability Monitor (LLM Insights + Sessions) module. traceGenAiParts.spec.js only covers GenAI v5 'parts' rendering inside the trace detail sidebar, not the /web/ai Monitor pages. The genAiTracesIngestionPage.ingestGenAiSpan helper is reusable for seeding LLM streams (and only needs a small extension to set status.code=2 for error-span sessions). This is a distinct feature area under the existing Traces shard, so a new spec file is warranted. Folder (Traces) + area tag (@traces) match the feature.
